mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over a 3-month period indicates a strengthening demand for housing, which boosts related industries and overall economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods where HOUST increased over a 3-month period.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within a month signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to increased prices and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where INDPRO decreased by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.3% in a month, it indicates high inflation coupled with tight monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.3% in 1 month
regime_hint: high inflation and tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2%, it signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over a 3-month period indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods where RSAFS increased over a 3-month period.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) increases by more than 1% in a month and GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 0.5% quarter-over-quarter, it signals a robust expansion in supply and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases > 1% in 1 month and GDPC1 grows > 0.5% QoQ
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger conditions are met.
